profile_name: Move cover ON — opt-in, not shipped
description: Enables FIX_MOVE_COVER: a unit making a normal move toward its plan objective ends the move Hidden (11e 13.09 as errata'd: INFANTRY/BEASTS/SWARM within a light or dense terrain area, no ranged attacks this or the previous turn) or in cover (13.08, -1 BS) from every enemy shooter that can reach it next turn, searching the whole disc the move can reach (a full-length move can slide along it) and giving up at most MOVE_COVER_MAX_LOSS_INCHES of objective progress. Paired with HIDDEN_FORFEIT_PENALTY (F002) at its corpus-suggested 3.0: Hidden is credited only where the unit has no target in range or F002 would hold fire (the shot on offer is worth less than the Hidden it would forfeit — chip shots only); with a worthwhile target the spot counts as cover. The cover_gain plan prior stays OFF in this arm (MOVE_COVER_PLAN_WEIGHT 0): its effect on the greedy assignment cannot be fire-tagged, so the fire gate counts only the executor's '[FIX_MOVE_COVER] <unit> end spot' line. NOT the shipped default (both ship at 0); this is the arm to load for the fire gate / paired A/B, and what tests/scenarios/sp/ai_move_cover.json loads. Exam: tests/exams/mv05_end_the_move_hidden.json.
